item.title: Version 0.13.1
item.description:
0.13.1

  • Fixed: onboarding's "Get Started" button, and Preferences → Calendars' "Allow Access" button, could take a click or two to respond (or seem to do nothing) on a window that wasn't already active
  • Onboarding now has its own "Allow Access" button for Calendar and for Accessibility, each showing "Access granted" once done — instead of just explaining what's about to be requested later
  • The header now shows "No more events today" instead of a same-as-now "Next free" time once nothing is left on the calendar for the rest of the day

item.title: Version 0.13.0
item.description:
0.13.0

  • Fixed: entering a license key (or a trial user just opening the license window) could leave the sidebar hidden until relaunch
  • Fixed: "Keep Windows Off Sidebar" could show a checkmark before Accessibility permission was actually granted
  • Fixed: a window that refuses to resize no longer gets fought over five times a second
  • Fixed: changing sidebar side or width in Preferences now applies immediately, even while collapsed
  • Fixed: fullscreen and other-Space windows are no longer clamped against the sidebar
  • Fixed two rare crashes: an empty-layout timing window in the timeline, and a first-launch preferences bug
  • New: pick a default calendar for new events and dropped time blocks (Preferences → Calendars)

item.title: Version 0.12.0
item.description:
0.12.0

  • Live Markdown editor for event notes, saves automatically
  • Export notes as a Markdown file to a folder of your choice
  • Onboarding flow and a "Launch at Login" option for new users
  • Jump to the current time in the timeline
  • "Next free slot" visible right in the header
  • Join target for live meetings now also in the collapsed strip; drag an event straight onto a time block
  • The frontmost app's windows are now correctly kept clear of the sidebar area on every edge, not just the assigned one
  • Events can now be renamed and deleted
  • App downloads are now notarized by Apple — no more Gatekeeper warning on first launch

item.title: Version 0.11.0
item.description:
0.11.0

  • Join icon right on the timeline's event block — no popover needed, highlighted in color for events in progress
  • Notes on any event, regardless of time or a detected meeting link, right in the event detail view
  • New notes mode: clicking the notes icon (or ⌥-clicking the event block) turns the expanded sidebar into a full notes view that slides in from the screen edge
  • Notes save automatically, no Save button needed
  • A central, searchable notes overview in Preferences
  • Optional: also write notes into the event description in Apple Calendar (off by default)

item.title: Version 0.10.0
item.description:
0.10.0

  • Meeting links are now detected — one click on "Join" opens Zoom/Meet/Teams/Webex/FaceTime directly
  • Reschedule events by drag and drop (15-minute grid, live time readout while dragging)
  • The event detail view now shows the organizer, attendees with RSVP status, and an "Open in Calendar" action
  • Reworked the "New Event" dialog
  • Preferences fully restructured: a sidebar with categories instead of one long list, calendars grouped by account
  • New option: hide the sidebar from screenshots and screen recordings
  • Send a diagnostics report by email (menu bar and Preferences)
  • New app icon
  • Various bug fixes, including to "Keep Windows Off Sidebar"

item.title: Version 0.9.1
item.description:
0.9.1

  • 14-day trial and licensing via Lemon Squeezy
  • Custom app icon
  • DMG download for manual first-time installation

item.title: Version 0.9.0
item.description:
0.9.0

  • First public preview build
  • Day-calendar sidebar with an expand/collapse handle
  • Auto-updates via Sparkle
